attackSkills.name: Blade Strike
attackSkills.effect: `melee` `physical`. Hit for 4–5; 30% chance to make the target Bleed.

attackSkills.name: Polearm Thrust
attackSkills.effect: `melee` `physical`. Hit for 4–5, with one row more reach than other melee.

attackSkills.name: Heavy Blow
attackSkills.effect: `melee` `physical`. Hit for 5–6; 30% chance to Stun the target for 5 time units.

attackSkills.name: Breath
attackSkills.effect: `direct`, Range D1. Hit the target for 3–4 and every unit next to it for 1–2.

attackSkills.name: Lash
attackSkills.effect: `melee` `physical`. Hit for 3–4, with one row more reach than other melee.

attackSkills.name: Pulse
attackSkills.effect: `direct`. Every enemy in melee reach takes 2–3.

professionSkills.name: Stalk
professionSkills.effect: The Hunter gains stealth. Needs the Hunter outside the Front row.

professionSkills.name: Creep Closer
professionSkills.effect: Only while stealthed: move to an adjacent row on your side without breaking stealth.

professionSkills.name: Freeze in Place
professionSkills.effect: When an area effect hits the stealthed Hunter, 50% chance to stay stealthed (it still takes the damage).

professionSkills.name: Lie in Wait
professionSkills.effect: Only while stealthed: pick a unit in melee reach. The next time it uses a skill, it is Stunned for 10 time units before that skill resolves (this breaks the Hunter's stealth). That skill is lost: its Momentum cost and Delay are still paid, the Stun lands first and the skill has no effect (decided 2026-11-08).

professionSkills.name: Vanish
professionSkills.effect: Gain stealth, even in the Front row.

professionSkills.name: Read Tracks
professionSkills.effect: Pick a row. Every stealthed unit in it is revealed.

professionSkills.name: Scent
professionSkills.effect: Marked enemies cannot gain stealth.

professionSkills.name: Scent of Blood
professionSkills.effect: When an enemy's HP falls below 20%, it becomes Marked.

professionSkills.name: Target
professionSkills.effect: Mark any visible unit (one Mark from this Hunter at a time; marking another moves it).

professionSkills.name: Sniff the Air
professionSkills.effect: At battle start, the enemy with the highest Power becomes Marked.

professionSkills.name: Decoy
professionSkills.effect: When a Marked enemy attacks the Hunter, the Hunter leaves a decoy (HP 10) in its place and appears one row behind. The decoy takes the hit: the Hunter swaps out before the attack resolves and the attack is aimed at the decoy (decided 2026-11-08). No decoy if the Hunter is in the Rear row or cannot move back.

professionSkills.name: Net Trap
professionSkills.effect: HP 4. A unit that hits it has +3 Delay on its next skill.

professionSkills.name: Cage
professionSkills.effect: A unit in melee reach is Immobilized for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Cut Off Retreat
professionSkills.effect: A Marked unit is Immobilized for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Flush
professionSkills.effect: Pull a Marked unit into its own Front row (bumps apply). It loses stealth.

professionSkills.name: Pack Strike
professionSkills.effect: Every ally that hit a Marked unit since the Hunter's last turn has its next turn pulled forward 3.

professionSkills.name: Shield Wall
professionSkills.effect: Needs 3 or more of your units side by side in the Guardian's row. For 10 time units, attacks aimed at units behind the wall are always intercepted by the wall.

professionSkills.name: Hold Position
professionSkills.effect: Enemy effects cannot push, pull or swap the Guardian.

professionSkills.name: Full Cover
professionSkills.effect: When the Guardian intercepts, it always takes the whole hit, never a partial one.

professionSkills.name: Living Wall
professionSkills.effect: The Guardian always intercepts for the units directly behind it, but it can never attack.

professionSkills.name: Leap to Defend
professionSkills.effect: Own side only. The Guardian moves next to an ally anywhere on your side (any gap) and takes the next attack on that ally instead of it.

professionSkills.name: Rescue
professionSkills.effect: Own side only. Swap places with an ally within distance 2 that is below half HP.

professionSkills.name: Take a Charge
professionSkills.effect: Own side only. An ally becomes the Guardian's Charge (one at a time; choosing another moves it).

professionSkills.name: Follow the Charge
professionSkills.effect: When the Charge moves or is moved, the Guardian may move with it to stay lined up in front of it.

professionSkills.name: Distract
professionSkills.effect: The enemy that last hit the Charge must target the Guardian with its next attack, if it can.

professionSkills.name: Pledge
professionSkills.effect: For 10 time units, area effects that would hit the Charge hit the Guardian instead.

professionSkills.name: Ward
professionSkills.effect: A unit within distance 2 gains a Ward of 4 until the Guardian's next turn.

professionSkills.name: Lasting Ward
professionSkills.effect: Ward lasts until it is broken, not until the Guardian's next turn.

professionSkills.name: Overcharged Ward
professionSkills.effect: A unit gains a Ward of 8 that lasts only until that unit's next turn.

professionSkills.name: Shield Dome
professionSkills.effect: Every ally gains a Ward of 2 until the Guardian's next turn.

professionSkills.name: Keeper of the Gate
professionSkills.effect: Your barricades have double HP, but the Guardian itself cannot intercept.

professionSkills.name: Mend
professionSkills.effect: Heal one unit for 8–10.

professionSkills.name: Rain of Mending
professionSkills.effect: Pick a row: every unit in it is healed for 3–4.

professionSkills.name: Overflowing Care
professionSkills.effect: Healing beyond the target's max HP goes to its adjacent ally with the lowest HP.

professionSkills.name: Downpour
professionSkills.effect: Rain of Mending also heals the row behind for half.

professionSkills.name: Absolve
professionSkills.effect: Remove every harmful status from one unit; its next turn is pushed back 2.

professionSkills.name: Dispel
professionSkills.effect: Remove every helpful status (Ward, Haste, stealth and others) from a unit within distance 3.

professionSkills.name: Mass Dispel
professionSkills.effect: Remove every helpful status from every unit in one row.

professionSkills.name: Steal Blessing
professionSkills.effect: Move one helpful status from one unit onto another.

professionSkills.name: Turn Back
professionSkills.effect: Move one harmful status from a unit onto the unit that applied it.

professionSkills.name: Revive
professionSkills.effect: Revive a KO unit at 25% of its max HP (rounded down, minimum 1).

professionSkills.name: Life Link
professionSkills.effect: Link two units for 10 time units: healing on one also heals the other for half.

professionSkills.name: Bound Resurrect
professionSkills.effect: Revive a KO unit at 25% of its max HP (rounded down, minimum 1); it and the Healer share one HP pool (game_system §10.4).

professionSkills.name: Burnout Heal
professionSkills.effect: Heal every unit around the Healer for 6–8; the Healer is KO (§10.4).

professionSkills.name: Life for Life
professionSkills.effect: The Healer gives up half its current HP to revive a KO unit with that much HP.

professionSkills.name: Bound Strength
professionSkills.effect: While the two units share their HP pool, both have 1 less Delay on every skill.

professionSkills.name: Echo Enchant
professionSkills.effect: A unit's next skill happens twice: the second use is free (no Delay, no Momentum) and hits the same target.

professionSkills.name: Phase Weapon
professionSkills.effect: A unit's next attack has unlimited range.

professionSkills.name: Phasing Strike
professionSkills.effect: The attack also cannot be intercepted.

professionSkills.name: Piercing Enchant
professionSkills.effect: A unit's next attack also hits the unit behind its target.

professionSkills.name: Enchanted Soul
professionSkills.effect: The Sorcerer's enchantments last until used, but only one can be active at a time.

professionSkills.name: Petrify
professionSkills.effect: A unit turns to stone: it is Stunned for 10 time units.

professionSkills.name: Transmute
professionSkills.effect: A unit's Power and Speed swap values for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Stone Shell
professionSkills.effect: A unit turns to stone for 10 time units: it cannot act and cannot be damaged. This is a status and can be cleansed.

professionSkills.name: Lasting Transmute
professionSkills.effect: Transmute lasts 40 time units.

professionSkills.name: Glass Body
professionSkills.effect: The next hit on a unit deals double damage.

professionSkills.name: Curse of Stagnation
professionSkills.effect: For 20 time units, statuses on a unit do not run down.

professionSkills.name: Curse of Betrayal
professionSkills.effect: For 20 time units, a unit's healing goes to your units instead.

professionSkills.name: Curse of Weight
professionSkills.effect: A unit cannot Move or become airborne for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Lingering Malice
professionSkills.effect: When an enemy removes one of the Sorcerer's curses or hexes, the remover is Silenced for 10 time units.

professionSkills.name: Witch's Patience
professionSkills.effect: The Sorcerer's curses last until removed, but it can keep only one curse at a time.

professionSkills.name: Row of Fire
professionSkills.effect: Set fire to a whole row for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Kindle
professionSkills.effect: Set fire to a unit's spot.

professionSkills.name: Backdraft
professionSkills.effect: A unit standing on burning ground: the fire on its spot spreads to every spot next to it.

professionSkills.name: Fire Lane
professionSkills.effect: Set fire to a unit's spot and to the spots in the same column in every other row of its side.

professionSkills.name: Scorch
professionSkills.effect: The fire from Kindle also spreads to the spots next to it.

professionSkills.name: Ignition Point
professionSkills.effect: Backdraft refreshes the fire's duration to 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Chain Lightning
professionSkills.effect: Stuns a unit for 5 time units, then jumps to an adjacent unit and Stuns it, then once more.

professionSkills.name: Shock
professionSkills.effect: Stuns any unit for 10 time units; it cannot be intercepted.

professionSkills.name: Arc
professionSkills.effect: Chain Lightning jumps 2 more times.

professionSkills.name: Tempest
professionSkills.effect: Push every unit in one row one row back (bumps apply). No extra hit.

professionSkills.name: Megavolt
professionSkills.effect: Every unit in one row is Stunned for 5 time units; the Elementalist is Silenced for 10 time units.

professionSkills.name: Steam Burst
professionSkills.effect: When fire is set on an iced spot, both end and the unit there is Confused for 10 time units.

professionSkills.name: Freeze
professionSkills.effect: A unit is Frozen.

professionSkills.name: Glacier
professionSkills.effect: Every unit in one row is Frozen.

professionSkills.name: Brittle
professionSkills.effect: Frozen enemies take 50% more damage.

professionSkills.name: Frost Nova
professionSkills.effect: Every enemy in melee reach of the Elementalist is Frozen.

professionSkills.name: Cold Heart
professionSkills.effect: Frozen from the Elementalist lasts 1 more turn, but it can keep only one unit Frozen at a time.

professionSkills.name: Reckless Swing
professionSkills.effect: The Warrior's hits deal double damage, but the Warrior takes half of the damage it deals (rounded down).

professionSkills.name: Unstoppable
professionSkills.effect: Below a quarter of its HP, the Warrior cannot be Immobilized or Frozen, and its turns cannot be pushed back.

professionSkills.name: Endure
professionSkills.effect: Damage from statuses cannot drop the Warrior below 1 HP.

professionSkills.name: Last Stand
professionSkills.effect: The Warrior cannot Move or be moved, but deals 50% more damage.

professionSkills.name: Challenge
professionSkills.effect: Mark a unit (one Mark from this Warrior at a time).

professionSkills.name: Drag Out
professionSkills.effect: Pull a Marked unit one row toward the battle line.

professionSkills.name: Isolate
professionSkills.effect: Push every unit adjacent to a Marked unit one row back, leaving it alone.

professionSkills.name: Hunt Down
professionSkills.effect: When a Marked enemy is moved, the Warrior Stuns it for 5 time units.

professionSkills.name: Execution
professionSkills.effect: A Marked unit below 25% HP is KO.

professionSkills.name: Single Combat
professionSkills.effect: For 10 time units, the Warrior and one Marked unit can be targeted only by each other.

professionSkills.name: Sweeping Kick
professionSkills.effect: Push every unit in melee reach one row back (bumps apply).

professionSkills.name: Crowd Fighter
professionSkills.effect: While three or more enemies are in its melee reach, the Warrior's attacks hit all of them.

professionSkills.name: Battle Roar
professionSkills.effect: Every unit in melee reach has its next turn pushed back 5 time units.

professionSkills.name: Sidestep
professionSkills.effect: The next attack on the Warrior misses.

professionSkills.name: Counter Step
professionSkills.effect: When an attack on the Warrior misses, its next turn is pulled forward 5 time units.

professionSkills.name: Hit and Run
professionSkills.effect: Strike a unit in melee for 3–4: its next action comes 3 time units later, then the Warrior moves one row back.

professionSkills.name: Swap Turns
professionSkills.effect: Own side only. Two allies swap their places on the timeline.

professionSkills.name: Press the Advantage
professionSkills.effect: A unit's next skill costs no Momentum.

professionSkills.name: Inspiring Presence
professionSkills.effect: When an ally next to the Leader KOs an enemy, Momentum moves 1 more toward your side.

professionSkills.name: All In
professionSkills.effect: The Leader's Momentum costs are halved (rounded up), but Momentum gained from its hits is 0.

professionSkills.name: Reposition
professionSkills.effect: Own side only. Move an ally one row, to any gap, at no cost to its timeline.

professionSkills.name: Fall Back
professionSkills.effect: Own side only. Move every ally in the Front row one row back (bumps apply).

professionSkills.name: Advance
professionSkills.effect: Own side only. Move every ally in one row one row forward (bumps apply).

professionSkills.name: Switch Places
professionSkills.effect: Own side only. Two allies swap places.

professionSkills.name: Rotation
professionSkills.effect: Own side only. Every ally moves one row back, and the Rear row moves to the Front.

professionSkills.name: Drill
professionSkills.effect: An ally the Leader moves has its next turn pulled forward 3 time units.

professionSkills.name: Song of Haste
professionSkills.effect: Allies in the Leader's row have +1 Speed.

professionSkills.name: War Drums
professionSkills.effect: Allies next to the Leader cannot be Stunned or Frozen.

professionSkills.name: Rhythm
professionSkills.effect: When an ally uses the same skill twice in a row, the second use has 1 less Delay.

professionSkills.name: Solo Performer
professionSkills.effect: The Leader's Bard passives are twice as strong, but they reach only the Leader's own row.

professionSkills.name: Grand Chorus
professionSkills.effect: The Leader's Bard passives reach every ally, but the Leader can use no active skills except its type-specific attack.

professionSkills.name: Hide
professionSkills.effect: The Rogue gains stealth. Needs the Rogue outside the Front row.

professionSkills.name: Melt Away
professionSkills.effect: The Rogue gains stealth anywhere, even in the Front row.

professionSkills.name: Sneak
professionSkills.effect: While stealthed, the Rogue may move one row at the start of its turn, at no cost to its timeline and without losing stealth.

professionSkills.name: Lift a Skill
professionSkills.effect: Use a copy of the last active skill the target used, with the Rogue's own Power.

professionSkills.name: Light Fingers
professionSkills.effect: Whenever the Rogue hits an enemy that has a helpful status, it steals that status.

professionSkills.name: Backstab
professionSkills.effect: Only from stealth: the target is Silenced and Bleeds, and the Rogue stays stealthed.

professionSkills.name: Contract
professionSkills.effect: The Rogue deals double to Marked enemies and half to everyone else.

professionSkills.name: Poison Vial
professionSkills.effect: Throw a vial: poison ground on a unit's spot for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Mark for Death
professionSkills.effect: Mark a unit for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Deathmark Bloom
professionSkills.effect: When a Marked enemy is KO, its Mark jumps to the nearest enemy.

professionSkills.name: Flash Powder
professionSkills.effect: Every unit in melee reach is Blind for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Cut the Strings
professionSkills.effect: Remove one auto event the other side has on the timeline.

professionSkills.name: Jam
professionSkills.effect: A unit's next skill has +3 Delay.

professionSkills.name: Disarm Trap
professionSkills.effect: The Rogue sets off enemy traps without taking their effect.

professionSkills.name: Bolt Turret
professionSkills.effect: Places a turret (HP 8). Each time the Tinker takes a turn, it hits the nearest enemy for 2–3.

professionSkills.name: Barricade
professionSkills.effect: Places a barricade (HP 10) on any free spot of your side.

professionSkills.name: Overclock
professionSkills.effect: Every construct of the Tinker acts once more right now.

professionSkills.name: Repair
professionSkills.effect: A construct heals 8.

professionSkills.name: Poison Gas
professionSkills.effect: Poison ground on a unit's spot and the spots beside it, for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Gas Cloud
professionSkills.effect: Poison ground on a whole row for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Healing Draught
professionSkills.effect: Throw a potion: a unit heals 6–7.

professionSkills.name: Antidote
professionSkills.effect: Remove Poison, Bleeding and Blind from a unit.

professionSkills.name: Plague Doctor
professionSkills.effect: The Tinker's poison ground lasts twice as long, but the Tinker cannot heal.

professionSkills.name: Firebomb
professionSkills.effect: Fire on a unit's spot and the spots beside it, for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Flame Turret
professionSkills.effect: Places a turret (HP 8). Each time the Tinker takes a turn, it sets fire to the spot of one enemy in front of it.

professionSkills.name: Flashbang
professionSkills.effect: Every unit in one row is Blind for 10 time units.

professionSkills.name: Showman
professionSkills.effect: The Tinker's Blind and Stunned last twice as long, but the Tinker's skills that deal damage have +2 Delay.

professionSkills.name: Raise Undead
professionSkills.effect: Turns one KO'd body from either side into an undead of yours, placed in a free slot: same art in an undead frame, its own basic attack, HP 12, Power 4. Healing damages it. When it dies it leaves its body on your side.

professionSkills.name: Corpse Explosion
professionSkills.effect: A body or an undead of the Summoner explodes: 6 to every unit next to it. An exploding undead takes the 6 as well; a body stays where it is.

professionSkills.name: Mass Grave
professionSkills.effect: Raise Undead also raises one more random body.

professionSkills.name: Plague Corpse
professionSkills.effect: Every unit hit by the explosion is Poisoned for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Desecrate
professionSkills.effect: A KO'd body cannot be revived for 40 time units.

professionSkills.name: Lich Form
professionSkills.effect: The Summoner counts as undead (healing hurts it), but every undead of the Summoner has +2 Power.

professionSkills.name: Clay Golem
professionSkills.effect: Summons a golem (HP 25, Speed 3) that makes melee hits for 5–6. The plain, sturdy golem.

professionSkills.name: Rune Golem
professionSkills.effect: Summons a rune golem (HP 18, Speed 4) that makes melee hits for 3–4; each hit Silences the target for 10 time units.

professionSkills.name: Clockwork Golem
professionSkills.effect: Summons a clockwork golem (HP 16, Speed 5) that makes melee hits for 3–4; each time it acts, the Summoner's next action moves 2 time units sooner.

professionSkills.name: Bell Golem
professionSkills.effect: Summons a bell golem (HP 18, Speed 4) that does not attack; each time it acts, every ally next to it loses one status.

professionSkills.name: Golem Heart
professionSkills.effect: The Summoner can keep only one golem, but it has double HP.

professionSkills.name: Animate Blades
professionSkills.effect: Summons flying blades (HP 6, Speed 7) that make ranged hits for 2–3. Lasts 30 time units.

professionSkills.name: Portal
professionSkills.effect: The Summoner's summons appear on a random free spot of your side instead of being placed.

professionSkills.name: Blade Storm
professionSkills.effect: Animate Blades summons two sets of blades.

professionSkills.name: Animate Mirror
professionSkills.effect: Summons a mirror (HP 8, Speed 5) that answers each hit on it with the attacker's own basic attack. Lasts 30 time units.

professionSkills.name: Healing Totem
professionSkills.effect: Places a totem (HP 8): allies in its row regain 2 HP every 10 time units.

professionSkills.name: Spirit Link Totem
professionSkills.effect: Places a totem (HP 10): damage to allies in its row is split evenly between them.

professionSkills.name: Totem of Return
professionSkills.effect: Places a totem (HP 6): the first ally in its row that would be KO keeps 1 HP instead, and the totem breaks.

professionSkills.name: Great Totem
professionSkills.effect: The Primalist keeps only 1 totem, but it has triple HP and also affects the rows next to it.

professionSkills.name: Rain Dance
professionSkills.effect: Water on every spot of one row (§12.2).

professionSkills.name: Hoarfrost
professionSkills.effect: Ice on a unit's spot (§12.2).

professionSkills.name: Totem Ritual
professionSkills.effect: Every totem of the Primalist regains all its HP.

professionSkills.name: Long Rain
professionSkills.effect: Rain Dance's water lasts 20 time units longer.

professionSkills.name: Healing Rain
professionSkills.effect: Allies in the rain regain 4 HP.

professionSkills.name: Rite of Mists
professionSkills.effect: Ranged hits from units standing on water deal half damage for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Puppet Soul
professionSkills.effect: Possession. A unit hits a unit next to it at once with its basic attack.

professionSkills.name: Life Swap
professionSkills.effect: Soul swap. Two units swap their HP as a share of their maximum.

professionSkills.name: Forced Step
professionSkills.effect: Possession. A unit moves to a free spot of your choice on its own side.

professionSkills.name: Linked Fates
professionSkills.effect: Soul swap. For 20 time units, one unit also takes half of all damage another unit takes.

professionSkills.name: Shared Fate
professionSkills.effect: Soul swap. For 20 time units, two units each also take half of the damage the other takes.

professionSkills.name: Airlift
professionSkills.effect: Own side only. Moves an ally to any free spot of your side.

professionSkills.name: Take Off
professionSkills.effect: For 20 time units the unit is airborne (game_system §10.6): melee cannot reach it and it ignores ground effects; it uses its skills as normal.

professionSkills.name: High Altitude
professionSkills.effect: Take Off lasts 40 time units.

professionSkills.name: Sky Lord
professionSkills.effect: The unit is always airborne, but has 30% less HP (rounded down).

professionSkills.name: Scout Ahead
professionSkills.effect: Reveals stealthed units in every row of one side for 10 time units.

professionSkills.name: Spotter
professionSkills.effect: A unit is Marked for 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Long Watch
professionSkills.effect: Marks the unit places last 10 time units longer.

professionSkills.name: Watchtower
professionSkills.effect: While airborne, the unit repeats Scout Ahead on its own every 20 time units.

professionSkills.name: Boundless Sky
professionSkills.effect: While airborne, all the unit's skills have unlimited range.

professionSkills.name: Gust
professionSkills.effect: Wind. Pushes a unit one row back.

professionSkills.name: Headwind
professionSkills.effect: Wind. A unit's next action comes 5 time units later.

professionSkills.name: Turbulence
professionSkills.effect: Wind. Every airborne unit, on both sides, lands.

professionSkills.name: Dust Up
professionSkills.effect: Wind. A unit is Blind for 10 time units.
